system.description: As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save gains one rank of Weakened for the next minute. At the end of the affected creatures turn, they make a Constitution saving throw, on a failure, they gain an additional rank of Weakened for the duration. If they succeed this save three times, they end this effect and remove all ranks of Weakened gained by this bane.
